name: career-render
description: Render ../resume.json to HTML and PDF with a JSON Resume theme.

scripts.html: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('out',{recursive:true})" && resumed render ../resume.json --theme jsonresume-theme-even --output out/resume.html && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.appendFileSync('out/resume.html','<style>'+fs.readFileSync('print.css','utf8')+'</style>')"
scripts.pdf: npm run html && node pdf.mjs out/resume.html out/resume.pdf
scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run pdf
